Thanks, Jeff — that makes sense! How about the below?
With reference to my last email, IPI is organizing a conference on "Preparing for Pandemics: Lessons Learned for More
Effective Responses." The following speakers have already confirmed their attendance: Margaret Chan, Director-General
of the WHO, Peter Maurer, President of the ICRC, and Michael Moller, head of the UN Office in Geneva.
The conference will look at a global 'defence system' related to future pandemics. It will be strictly policy oriented,
towards a reform of the current system and to setting up possible new mechanism for resilience and the management of
future crises.
The idea springs out of your thinking on this matter, which has already found broad resonance — as for instance voiced by
Chancellor Angela Merkel recently. I do believe that the threat of future pandemics will be one of the most serious future
challenges to the multilateral system and to mankind.
I think for you to give the keynote address at the opening of our conference would be profoundly instrumental to move
the necessary measure forward, and I do hope that your calendar will allow you to be present. The conference will be
held on September 11-12, and your presence would only be required for about 2 hours in the Palais de Nations in Geneva
on September 12th.
The event is fully financed and will not require further financial assistance.
I hope your foundation is happy with the cooperation with IPI so far. We were very pleased with the recent meetings that
took place in Seattle with the team, and in New York and Geneva with Christopher Elias. And I am looking forward to
future cooperation in multiple fields.
If you would have the time, I think it would be useful if we could meet in the near future. I will be in Europe for the next
two weeks, and could meet you on short notice.
Warmest,
Terje
